answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 97 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in zenith, queued in falcon, and wander publishes the wait time. A farm of 239 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3944 identities would post 1874 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
